capabilities: Create sections with headings and link rows in an index note
Archive and unarchive rows via hover buttons
Insert a clickable section index at the top of the note
Move linked section pages into per-section folders
Store each note's images and videos in a per-note media folder
disambiguation: Not a Notion-style block editor; it adds heading-based link sections to one note and files the pages and media those sections reference.
extras: README warns that the organize commands move files and rewrite links and recommends backing up the vault (Obsidian Sync or git) first. Interface is available in English and Chinese. Works on its own; Paipa Gallery and Editor Enhancer integrations are optional.
problem: Index notes turn into ever-growing link lists where finished items clutter the view, new pages pile up in the vault root, and images land in one shared attachments folder.

relations.evidence: With Paipa Gallery, files dropped into a gallery follow the same <note> media rule
with Editor Enhancer, sections join its block menu

summary: Adds heading sections with link rows, a folded archive, and a section index to index notes, and files linked pages and media into folders.
